```{r setup}
source("R/cv_functions.R")
cv <- load_cv("data/cv.yml")
p  <- cv$person
n  <- counts(cv)
today <- format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y")
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
if (is_pdf()) {
  cat(glue("\\newcommand{{\\cvfootleft}}{{{today}}}\n\\newcommand{{\\cvfootcentre}}{{{p$name} · Curriculum Vitae}}\n"))
  photo <- if (file.exists("images/photo.jpg")) "images/photo.jpg" else ""
  contact <- glue(
    "\\faEnvelope\\ {p$email} \\quad \\faGlobe\\ {p$website} \\quad ",
    "\\faGithub\\ {p$github} \\quad \\faLinkedin\\ {p$linkedin} \\quad \\faGraduationCap\\ Google Scholar",
    if (nzchar(p$orcid)) glue(" \\quad \\faOrcid\\ {p$orcid}") else "")
  cat(glue("\\cvheader{{{p$name}}}{{{p$position}}}{{{p$affiliation}}}{{{contact}}}{{{p$profile_academic}}}{{{photo}}}\n"))
} else {
  out(glue("# {p$name}, {p$credentials}"))
  out(glue("**{p$position}**, {p$affiliation}  "))
  out(glue("{p$email} | {p$phone} | https://{p$website} | github.com/{p$github} | linkedin.com/in/{p$linkedin}"))
  out(glue("*{p$profile_academic}*"))
}
```

# Peer-reviewed publications

```{r, results='asis'}
out(glue("Published (**{n$pubs}**) and under review or submitted (**{n$review}**). Earlier publications appear under the name H. G. J. T. Kumara."))
out("## Published")
numbered_list(map_chr(cv$publications, format_pub))
out("## Under review and submitted")
numbered_list(map_chr(cv$under_review, format_pub, with_status = TRUE))
out("## Conference proceedings")
numbered_list(map_chr(cv$proceedings, "text"))
```
